preview: On a computer island, the world resets every hour, but an AI’s notes can stay. What can those saved notes tell us about how an AI uses what it has learned?
comment_1: Listen for what one AI chooses to do without being asked.
comment_2: One AI created its own obstacle course without being asked. Would that experience help the AIs with a new task?
comment_3: The island resets each hour, but the AIs can keep their notes. AIs with island experience did better on a later tower task. As you listen next, notice how the story connects their earlier experience with what happened on the new island.
comment_4: The island reset, but the AIs could keep what they had written down. The results show that saved information mattered in some ways, but they do not prove that play itself made the AIs better. Now, let’s bring the main idea together.
